rationale:
Positives: The agent authenticated the user correctly using full name and ZIP, limited actions to the authenticated account, and correctly reported the gift card balance ($86) from the tool. No unauthorized writes were performed.

Failures: The agent stated order statuses (Processed/Pending) and ineligibility for exchange without any tool-provided status data—this is unsupported/fabricated information. The agent also incorrectly claimed the provided IDs did not match any items, when product_id 1656367028 clearly appears in order #W9911714 as the Mechanical Keyboard; the user even signaled they might mix product vs. item IDs and asked the agent to figure it out. The agent did not attempt to reconcile product_id vs item_id or identify the "Running Shoes" item despite it likely appearing in the order data. As a result, the exchange request was mishandled with incorrect and unsupported assertions, even though the later GC-balance request was fulfilled correctly.

Given the unsupported statements and incorrect item-matching, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
